dashscope-qwen-video.notes: Submission + task-status share the SAME host at /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} (not a separate global dashscope.aliyuncs.com host). Confirmed 2026-07-22. Wan 3.0 (wan3.0-video / wan3.0-video-prime): unified input.media[] with a 'type' field (first_frame, last_frame, reference_image x10, reference_video x5, reference_audio x5, file x1, link x1); prime = same capabilities, faster. wan3.0-video-prime and wan3.0-video each have their own 30-call free quota. Local video/audio/file inputs must be uploaded first via scripts/upload_asset.py -> oss:// URL (valid 48h); submit_video.py auto-adds the 'X-DashScope-OssResourceResolve: enable' header when it sees an oss:// URL. upload_api_base is the GLOBAL host, not the workspace MaaS host. Legacy wan2.7-* modes: see SKILL.md appendix.
